items.title: Sheila Jordan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Middleburgh, New York, May 11, 2002
items.q: I’ve gotten back together with Cameron Brown. Because originally he had rehearsed bass and voice with me... We’ll do it. We just did it last week in Europe

ctx.x: Yeah, exactly one step, right. But I remember that. And then I grabbed Steve Swallow, because he used to work at this club in the Village where I worked a couple of nights a week and on Monday nights he’d come in and play, and I started doing the things with him and then every once in a while we’d do a little date together. There was a club in the Village that did a lot of sort of avante garde type music called the Take Three, and it was upstairs. And we would go up there, carry the bass up there and do this…

wonderful. Yeah. And I’ve been doing it ever since. It’s just that now I’ve gotten back together with Cameron Brown. Because originally he had rehearsed bass and voice with me but then he got very busy with some of the other musicians you know. And he couldn’t rehearse as much. And then Harvey of course came in to the picture from the Steve Kuhn Quartet.
